flashcards.q: Order Azure compute options by control vs operations tradeoff.
flashcards.a: VMs (most control/ops) > VMSS > App Service > Container Apps > AKS (full Kubernetes control + full cluster ops). Each step right removes both operations AND control.

Uniform: identical instances, one model, ~1000 instance cap. Flexible: mixed sizes, zone/fault-domain spread like availability sets, attach existing VMs, count-based SLA; recommended for new deployments.

flashcards.q: Spot eviction notice and safe usage?
flashcards.a: ~30-second notice via Scheduled Events; safe for checkpointed stateless batch/CI with drain logic; irresponsible for single-instance stateful or latency-sensitive serving. Discounts often ~60-90% off PAYG.
Swap warms target then flips routing; slot-STICKY settings (connection strings etc.) travel with the slot NOT swapping - classic works-in-staging-breaks-in-prod inversion.
Basic ~3 instances/no slots; Standard ~10/5 slots; PremiumV3/MV3 ~20-30 instances/~20 slots. Always On required for background workloads and Functions-on-Dedicated.
min 0 / max 10 replicas (configurable to 1000), poll interval ~30 s, cooldown ~300 s, scale-down stabilization ~300 s, immediate scale-up; desiredReplicas = ceil(metric/target).
No vertical scaling (resize = new revision), replica counts are targets not guarantees, Dapr actor state incompatible with scale-to-zero; revisions immutable (~100 inactive kept).

flashcards.q: AKS version support window and upgrade skip rule?
flashcards.a: N-2 supported (+N-3 platform-support = platform issues only); upgrades can't skip more than one minor version per hop - sequential upgrades required.

flashcards.q: Azure CNI Overlay vs plain CNI?
flashcards.a: Overlay gives pods non-VNet overlay IPs (~250 pods/node default) conserving subnet space - current default. Plain CNI assigns real VNet IPs per pod - exhausts subnets causing Pending pods (FailedCreatePodSandBox).
Free control plane; Standard ~$0.10/hr adds 99.95% API-server uptime SLA; Premium adds long-term support. KEDA preconfigured in AKS Automatic.

flashcards.q: Little's Law sizing formula for compute fleets?
flashcards.a: concurrency = rps x latency_seconds; instances = peak_rps / (per_instance_capacity x utilization_target); check regional vCPU quota BEFORE debugging autoscale rules.

flashcards.q: Zone-redundancy pattern for stateless API + PostgreSQL?
flashcards.a: Stateless: VMSS-Flexible/App Service/CA spread across zones behind zone-redundant LB/Front Door. PostgreSQL Flexible zone-redundant HA puts sync standby in another zone (~99.99% vs 99.95% same-zone).

Right-size from utilization data first -> reservations/savings plans on baseline only -> spot for batch -> scale-to-zero/min-replicas tuning dev+test -> prune orphaned disks/IPs. Never reserve before right-sizing.

flashcards.q: Pods Pending with free CPU/memory - diagnostic order?
flashcards.a: IP exhaustion (FailedCreatePodSandBox, CNI) > taints/tolerations > topology constraints > PVC/zonal-disk mismatch > regional quota blocking node scale-up (read autoscaler logs).
